name: carousel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel.scss — MANIFEST for generic carousel chrome on
//  <custom-carousel> / the home carousel. Split by surface into carousel/
//  partials (imported below):
//    _track     shell + scroll-snap track + slides
//    _controls  controls row + WebGL arrow buttons + progress ring
//    _dots      indicators column + counter + dot/pill nav
//    _fallback  below-threshold horizontal strip + focus ring scope
//  Layout is driven by carousel.js geometry; these partials own the visual
//  chrome only.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

/// BEM block fragment — composed via interpolation so the 'carousel'
/// prefix is declared exactly once (DRY selector rule).
$_B_CAROUSEL: 'carousel';

/// Arrow-button hit area (square).
$carousel-btn-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
/// Dot diameter — inactive nav dots are small squares.
$carousel-dot-size: to-rem($space-md);
/// Pill length — the active dot stretches to a rounded pill.
$carousel-dot-pill: to-rem($space-xl);
/// Gap between nav dots.
$carousel-dot-gap: to-rem($space-xs);
/// Progress-ring stroke width around the arrow buttons.
$ring-stroke: to-rem(2.5);

@import 'carousel/track';
@import 'carousel/controls';
@import 'carousel/dots';
@import 'carousel/fallback';
